automatedOnboarding.title: Get set up to start designing
automatedOnboarding.body: When you select <bold>Continue</bold>, we'll automatically run two setup steps for you. No action is required from you. Once the steps are completed, you'll be ready to start designing in Forma Site Design.

contextual.body: We’ll load free contextual data for your site, including terrain and surrounding buildings.

sunAnalysis.body: We’ll run a sun hours analysis on your site and surroundings to inform your design decisions.

sunAnalysisCoachmark.body: We’ve automatically started a sun hours analysis on your site.{br}{br}Once the indicator is green or a banner is displayed at the top of the canvas, you can review the results.

finalModal.title: Your site is now set up
finalModal.subTitle: Continue with one of the recommended steps below:

suggestedAction1.body: Activate one of the building tools in the toolbar.

suggestedAction2.body: Click the import icon in the toolbar and follow the suggested steps.

suggestedAction3.body: Run a second analysis and open the Compare mode from the top left corner of the screen.

microclimate.description: Our microclimate analysis calculates perceived temperature on your site, taking sun, wind and daylight conditions into account. We recommend waiting until the wind analysis is completed for more accurate results.
microclimate.name: Microclimate

noise.description: Understand how your design impacts environmental noise conditions through a real-time prediction in the rapid noise analysis. Run a detailed noise analysis to get a more accurate simulation of noise conditions, as well as an analysis of the conditions on building facades.

sky-component.description: Assess which parts of the building facades get little access to daylight with the help of Vertical Sky Component score. To run the analysis, you need to add a site limit.

sun.description: Assess how many hours of sunlight your site and buildings will get. To run the analysis, you need to add a site limit and choose a date.

wind.description: Understand how your design changes impact wind conditions through a real-time prediction in the rapid wind analysis. Run a detailed wind flow and wind comfort analysis to get a more accurate simulation of different wind directions and speeds.
wind.name: Wind

explore.explanation: An ongoing effort in developing tools that can help you explore the massing potential of your site. Follow the development in our forum.

tutorialWidget.allTutorialsDescription: Complete these interactive guides to set up your site and start working in Site Design.
tutorialWidget.completionMessage: Well done! You've completed the {header} guide!

setUpYourSite.title: Set up your site
setUpYourSite.description: Add contextual data before you start modelling and analysing site and buildings.
setUpYourSite.reviewText: You’ve successfully added contextual data and a site limit.{br}{br}Great job! You can now explore our modelling tools and import capabilities, or continue with another guide.

openContextualTab.text: Start by opening the <bold>Contextual data</bold> tab.

browseAndOrder.text: Click <bold>Browse contextual data</bold> to see what data packages are available for your site location.{br}{br}Data may include surrounding buildings, roads and terrain.

orderStarterPackage.text: Click <bold>Add</bold> to review what’s include in this data package. This data is free.

orderData.text: Select order to initiate the download of 3D contextual data to your site.

drawSiteLimit.text: Activate this drawing tool to define your site limit. Once active, draw points around the site and enclose the shape.{br}{br}Having a site limit defined is a prerequisite to running analyses in Forma Site Design.

addBuildings.title: Add buildings
addBuildings.description: Create buildings with our modelling tools or import existing models.
addBuildings.reviewText: You’ve successfully drawn buildings and imported assets to your site. Great work! You can now assess environmental conditions by running analyses, or continue with another guide.

selectBuildingsTool.text: Click <bold>Basic building</bold> to activate the building tool. Once active, draw the shape of your building and select the last point to complete drawing the footprint.

exploreParametricOptions.text: Explore the parametric options available to modify your building model.

importModel.text: Click <bold>Import</bold> to upload a model or raster image from your local device.

placeInScene.text: Click on the item you just imported from the library. Once selected, place it on your site by clicking and dragging. The tutorial will advance automatically once the element is placed.

assessEnvironmentalConditions.title: Assess environmental conditions
assessEnvironmentalConditions.description: Run sun hours analysis to inform your early design decisions.
assessEnvironmentalConditions.reviewText: You’ve successfully ran a sun hours analysis on your site.{br}{br}You can now continue creating new proposals, comparing analysis or exploring more of Site Design.

selectAnalysis.text: Click the highlighted icon to select the sun hours analysis.

selectDate.text: Use the dropdown to set a date for which you'd like to analyze sun hours on your site.

runAnalysis.text: Click the button to initiate the analysis. It will only take a few seconds to complete.{br}{br}The guide will resume automatically once the analysis is completed.

openAnalysisResults.text: Once completed, the analysis results will be displayed in the list here. Click the latest results to review them in detail. A new window will open.

notSupported.text: Your computer does not seem to support WebGL, which is a requirement for using Forma
